pages.title: Omnium Energy Cell
pages.text: The last word in storage. Omnium lines the walls, the Omega Point sits at its heart, and the energy inside no longer obeys the usual bookkeeping. It is calm, featherlight, and seems to remember every charge it has held.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Beyond the singularity cell there was nowhere left to store energy, except at the end of everything. Binding an Omega Point to omnium gave me a cell that holds what the universe will eventually amount to.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.
